note: Better Messages restyles Drupal status/warning/error messages as animated, positionable popups via one config object better_messages.settings. Admin form route better_messages.settings_form (/admin/config/user-interface/better-messages), permission 'configure better messages'. Settings keys: position (center/tl/tr/bl/br), vertical, horizontal, fixed, width, autoclose (seconds; 0=off), disable_autoclose, show_countdown, hover_autoclose, opendelay, popin/popout {effect,duration}, jquery_ui {draggable,resizable}, visibility (condition plugin config). It also ships a Condition plugin message_type and a context provider better_messages.context. No Drush, no field/entity. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real config object; cleanup/reset restore the SHIPPED DEFAULTS explicitly (position center, autoclose 0, width 400px, draggable 1, resizable 0, fade in/out slow) rather than stashing baseline in State.

evals.prompt: Where do I configure the Better Messages module on a Drupal 11 site, which permission is needed, and which config object stores its settings?
evals.expected_output: Configure it at /admin/config/user-interface/better-messages (route better_messages.settings_form), which requires the 'configure better messages' permission. All settings live in the better_messages.settings config object.

evals.prompt: With Better Messages, how do I make popup messages automatically disappear after a few seconds, and how do I show a countdown or keep them open while the user hovers?
evals.expected_output: Set the 'autoclose' setting to the number of seconds (0 disables timed auto-close). show_countdown toggles the countdown timer and hover_autoclose keeps a message open while hovered. disable_autoclose can hard-disable auto-close.

evals.prompt: In Better Messages, how do I place the message box in a screen corner and let users drag or resize it? Name the relevant settings and any module dependencies.
evals.expected_output: Use the 'position' setting (center/tl/tr/bl/br) with vertical/horizontal offsets, and enable jquery_ui.draggable / jquery_ui.resizable. Dragging/resizing rely on the jquery_ui_draggable and jquery_ui_resizable modules (dependencies).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Better Messages has been configured with a non-default screen position. Inspect the live better_messages.settings configuration and state where the message box is positioned.
Better Messages on this site is set to auto-close popups after a fixed number of seconds. Inspect the live better_messages.settings configuration and report that auto-close time in seconds.
On this Drupal site, configure Better Messages so that popup messages automatically close after 5 seconds. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: better_messages.settings.autoclose is set to 5 (e.g. drush cset better_messages.settings autoclose 5, or via the settings form).
